chunks.heading: How do I reset my password?
chunks.text: Tap Forgot password on the login screen and follow the emailed reset link. No household admin needs to be involved.

chunks.heading: Can I merge two accounts?
chunks.text: Account merging is not currently automated. Contact support with both account email addresses and a support engineer will merge them manually.

chunks.heading: How do I transfer household ownership?
chunks.text: The current Owner can go to Household Settings > Transfer Ownership and select any existing Admin as the new Owner.

chunks.heading: What role does the previous owner get after a transfer?
chunks.text: The previous Owner is automatically demoted to Admin. They keep full device and automation access except for billing changes, which are locked for 24 hours as a safety cooldown.

chunks.heading: Can Guests be promoted to Members?
chunks.text: Yes. Any Admin or Owner can promote a Guest to a full Member from the household members list.
